Where to stay in Berlin

Every area rated for day and night, with the reasoning and the sources behind each rating. The map is below the table.

🟢 Official crime data · Polizei Berlin, Kriminalitätsatlas Methodology →

For a short stay in Berlin, the areas this map rates best are Regierungsviertel, Karl-Marx-Allee Nord, Frankfurter Allee Nord and Albrechtstraße. Each is picked from the ratings and the sights below, not chosen by hand — the reasoning is on the card.
